items.summary: Controls the bloom filter to be computed by the writer.

methods.summary: Returns a new [`BloomFilterPropertiesBuilder`] for constructing [`BloomFilterProperties`] with custom values.

methods.name: fpp
methods.summary: False positive probability. This should be always between 0 and 1 exclusive. Defaults to [`DEFAULT_BLOOM_FILTER_FPP`].

methods.name: ndv
methods.summary: Maximum expected number of distinct values. Defaults to [`DEFAULT_BLOOM_FILTER_NDV`].

methods.summary: Builds [`BloomFilterProperties`].

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Returns a new builder with no fields set.

methods.summary: Builds [`BloomFilterProperties`], returning an error instead of panicking when the configured `fpp` is not in `(0.0, 1.0)` exclusive.

methods.name: with_fpp
methods.summary: Sets the target false positive probability.

methods.name: with_max_ndv
methods.summary: Sets the maximum expected number of distinct values used to size the bloom filter before folding.
